get.description:
Whom the request acts for: its tenant, the user within it, and their role. Any member may ask;
an account with no membership gets 403 not_a_member.
The user's projects and the ones the tenant's other users share, the latest saved first.

post.description:
Queue the job that makes a version: an import of an upload, or an edit of a version. The job
is launched once its row is committed (docs/adr/0004); a launch that fails leaves it pending
for the scheduler (docs/adr/0007).

get.description: A project's versions, the newest first.

schema.title: Response List Versions Projects  Project Id  Versions Get

post.description: Queue a load flow of a version or a snapshot. Its result is the Studio's LoadFlowResult.
Queue a validation of a version or a snapshot. Its result is a ValidationResult.
Queue an export of a version or a snapshot: the file and its report, as artifacts.

Cancel a job: a pending one at once, a running one at the engine's next check, which stops its
work and stores nothing. 409 for one that has ended.

get.description: The jobs the user queued, newest first, at most 50.

propertyNames.description: The class that declares the attribute and its name, as EnergyConsumer.p

AddObject.title: AddObject
AddObject.description: Adds an object of a concrete CGMES 3.0 class, with a new mRID and its values.

Artifact.title: Artifact
Artifact.description: A stored file and where to download it from; `download_url` is valid for 30 minutes.

ExportIn.title: ExportIn
ExportIn.description: An export of the model to a file, with its report.

progress.title: Progress
progress.description: The stage it is at: waiting, starting, reading, running or storing

Job.title: Job
Job.description: Work the engine does outside the request. `result` says what it made once it is done.

role.title: Role
role.description: The role the request acts with: an editor at most for no work account

account_kind.title: Account Kind
account_kind.description: work: an organization's account, as its provider says; personal: anyone's; null while no sign-in has told

Me.title: Me
Me.description: Whom a request acts for: the tenant, the user within it, and their role there.

edited.title: Edited
edited.description: Whether the session's model was edited

PowerFlowIn.title: PowerFlowIn
PowerFlowIn.description: A load flow, the Studio's LoadFlowResult. `engine` is optional and an open one.

code.title: Code
code.description: Why the caller was refused: sign_in_required, sign_in_again, not_a_member, needs_role, second_factor_required or identity_unavailable

errors.title: Errors
errors.description: Each problem of a request that is not valid

Problem.title: Problem
Problem.description: An error, as RFC 9457 describes it, with the id of the request that met it.

where.title: Where
where.description: Where in the request, such as body.edits[0].op

mine.title: Mine
mine.description: Whether the user made it; only then may they change it

shared.title: Shared
shared.description: Whether the tenant's other users see it

Project.title: Project
Project.description:
One network model and its versions, what the Studio calls a saved model. A user sees their own
and the ones the tenant's other users share.

RemoveObject.title: RemoveObject
RemoveObject.description:
Removes an object, and with `dependents` the objects that exist only for it: its terminals,
their flows and limits, a transformer's ends. Once every edit applies, nothing may point at
what was removed.

attribute.title: Attribute
attribute.description: The class that declares the attribute and its name, as EnergyConsumer.p

SetAttribute.title: SetAttribute
SetAttribute.description: Sets one attribute of an object; null removes its value. A reference takes an mRID.

Source.title: Source
Source.description: What a job of the Studio's work reads: a version, or an artifact (a session's snapshot).

StoredFile.title: StoredFile
StoredFile.description: A stored file, known by its hash.

Upload.title: Upload
Upload.description: Where to upload one file: a PUT of it to `url`, with `headers`, before `expires_at`.

ValidationIn.title: ValidationIn
ValidationIn.description: A validation at the levels asked, worded by where the model's solution comes from.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: What a list shows of it, its bus count for one

previews.title: Previews
previews.description: The artifact of a picture of its diagram, by theme

Version.title: Version
Version.description:
One version of a project, a CGMES 3.0 model in a zip. Its file's kind says who made it:
`cgmes`, a job, with the profiles alone; `studio-project`, the Studio, a .gostudio that also
holds the Studio's layout and session files. `job_id` is the job that made it, null for a
Studio save, and that job has its conversion's result and report.

VersionIn.title: VersionIn
VersionIn.description:
A version from an uploaded file in a format the converter reads (`artifact_id` and `format`),
or from a version of the same project and CIM edits to it (`parent_id` and `edits`). A CGMES
model or a pf2xml export is uploaded as a zip of its files. `time_zone` is the requester's, an
IANA name ("America/Santiago"), which the conversion report is dated in; UTC when it is not
given or not known.
